prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: reusable transparent 2x2 character posture sprite sheet for an animated counting video.
Image1 is the canonical identity and drawing reference of the bear. Preserve its exact coral-red beret, pale-yellow body, big vertical brown eyes with white surrounds, small brown nose, original outer inverted-U muzzle contour and pink tongue. Keep the same warm brown hand-drawn outline and paper fill texture; no cheek blush. Do not make a different mascot, cat, human, clothing or shoes.
Create FOUR complete, separate clean silhouettes, one per equal quadrant, all on a genuinely transparent background, no shadows, no ground, no grid, no labels.
Top-left: normal standing bear, arms relaxed, facing directly forward, smiling.
Top-right: a brief halfway sitting-down / standing-up pose: knees gently bent and bottom lowered, feet flat, arms slightly forward for balance, body and head still facing directly forward.
Bottom-left: neutral seated bear, legs in front and feet resting on ground, both hands relaxed on lap, torso and head facing directly forward.
Bottom-right: the SAME seated bear stretching gently with both arms up and slightly apart, feet still resting, head and face still forward, happy mild expression.
This is an animation sequence, so identity, HEAD SIZE, eye spacing, muzzle, hat shape, outline weight and body scale must stay consistent in all four panels. Do not enlarge the seated head or shrink the standing head. Natural total standing height about500px within each627px quadrant; seated total height about380px and head width similar in all poses. Keep each silhouette centered on its quadrant, feet ground at about90% of each cell height. Every hat tip, ear, hand and foot stays at least25px from any cell edge.
Four limbs only: two arms and two legs. No double eyes, extra paws, missing hat, extra accessories or tilted resting head. No crossfaded or ghost silhouettes, no motion blur, no duplicate parts. Exact front view, friendly natural shapes. Output a square2x2 transparent PNG sprite sheet.
